The software product **Idyll** hosted at **`getidyll.in`** is provided directly by **Idyll** (also operating as **Idyll AI**), founded and developed by **Kushal Poddar**.

### Supporting Evidence and Citations
* **Official Privacy Policy Statement:** Section 1 (*Introduction*) of the Privacy Policy on `getidyll.in` defines the provider:  
  > *"Welcome to Idyll ('we,' 'our,' or 'us'). Idyll is an AI Virtual Girlfriend & Boyfriend platform that provides real-time voice conversations with AI companions. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information."*
* **Copyright Notice:** The website footer states:  
  > *"© 2023-2025 Idyll. All rights reserved."*
* **Developer/Founder Identification:** Public directory listings and articles hosted on `getidyll.in` identify **Kushal Poddar** as the founder and developer behind Idyll.
